title: Trump announces Audi's first-ever U.S. factory in Georgia at rally, defends tariffs
detail: At a rally, Trump announced that Audi will build its first-ever U.S. factory in Georgia, citing it as evidence that his tariffs are driving manufacturing investment, as he defended the tariff policy ahead of the November midterms.

media.caption: Trump announces Audi's first U.S. factory in Georgia

title: Trump says Canada tariff deal coming 'soon' at Michigan border rally
detail: At a rally near the Michigan-Canada border, Trump said a deal resolving the tariff dispute with Canada was coming 'soon', as he campaigned ahead of the November midterms.
